resources.string: Before you start
I understand and accept
In an emergency, call 112. This app does not replace the emergency services, the civil protection authorities, doctors or any other professional.
The information in this app is general and may not suit your situation. Always follow instructions from the authorities and from emergency services on the scene.
You use this app and its information at your own risk. Its authors and contributors accept no liability for any decision, action or omission based on it, or for any damage resulting from its use.

The texts in this app summarise official sources, shown with each step, but have not been reviewed by health or civil protection professionals. If in doubt, follow the original source and the authorities\' instructions.
Alerts shown in the app depend on public data and on your internet connection. They may be late, incomplete or unavailable. They are never real-time.
The app has no account, no ads and no tracking. Everything you enter stays on this phone.

Privacy
The app has no account, no ads, no analytics and no tracking. We do not run any server.

What you write (inventory, family plan, medical sheets, places and settings) stays on this phone only. Medical sheets are encrypted. This data is excluded from cloud backups and from phone-to-phone transfers.

The app only uses the internet to download public IPMA files (weather warnings and fire risk), and only if you choose an area. It downloads the national file: the request does not include your area or any identifier. Like any internet request, the IPMA server sees your IP address.

When you tap \"Call\", \"Open in maps\", \"Share\" or a source link, the app opens another app (dialler, maps, browser…) and gives it only what is needed for that action. What happens there follows that app\'s rules.
If you export your data, the file is saved where you choose. With a password it is encrypted.

Permissions: notifications (reminders and warnings, only if you turn them on), internet (IPMA files) and biometrics (optional lock for medical sheets). The app never asks for location, camera, contacts or calls.
To delete everything, uninstall the app or clear its data in the phone\'s settings.
